scope_notes: The 10-11 Nov Beijing snapshot is a filtered tracking-scope capture, not a claim to enumerate every global fixture listed by general aggregators.
No fixtures found in the seven core domestic leagues, EFL Championship, Segunda, Primeira, Eliteserien or Veikkausliiga for these two Beijing dates.
J.League Cup is filed as domestic cup, not J1 league. Women's UEFA competitions are filed as continental club competitions.
UEFA Women's Champions League and Europa Cup times were converted from CET; J.League Cup from JST; Copa Colombia from Colombia local time (UTC-5); EFL Trophy from UK GMT.
U23 and women's international friendlies were surfaced by FootyNomad but timezone was not exposed in the source display; UTC and Beijing times are intentionally left blank pending confirmation.

UEFA Women's Europa Cup seven other second legs on 11 Nov CET, UEFA Women's Champions League three 11 Nov CET fixtures, AFCON qualifiers and Supercopa Internacional fall on 12 Nov Beijing and are outside this two-date window.

correction_notes: Clarified the Junior-Cúcuta source state: the source snapshot displayed 1-0 at 86', but that status timestamp is not exposed and cannot be asserted as live at the 10:02 capture. The official kickoff time is retained; current/final status is unconfirmed.
Separated fixtures with verified kickoff conversions from international friendly discoveries whose source timezone is not disclosed.
Corrected category count labels; no match was marked confirmed-finished merely because its kickoff date was confirmed.

Expanded the EFL Trophy to all 19 fixture candidates shown by FootyNomad: 12 are also listed by the official EFL competition page; 7 are retained as secondary-only candidates, with kickoff timezone/time conversion left blank where not confirmed.
Expanded the Colombian domestic league schedule with the official DIMAYOR Torneo BetPlay fixture Envigado vs Boca Juniors de Cali.
For Copa del Rey, four kickoffs are UTC-labelled on MatchCalendar; two additional fixtures are retained from FootyNomad as secondary-only with UTC/Beijing times left blank.

Junior FC-Cúcuta Deportivo is now confirmed final 2-0 by the official DIMAYOR homepage. The earlier secondary live 1-0/86' snapshot was stale and is retained only as source history, not treated as the final result.
